verdict.rationale: Compliance certifications and data residency are a fair question for a hosted voice-AI platform, but the evidence pack never mentions HIPAA, a BAA, SOC 2, or data-residency options. The only related item is per-agent data retention with automatic deletion, which is an adjacent control rather than the requested certifications or residency choice, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run regulated workloads with HIPAA/BAA support, SOC 2, and data-residency options
